parent_objective: design no-rerun offtrack failure-slice diagnosis over M2244 and M2253 episode rows
blocked_by: M2254 pivots because scalar reward repair worsened offtrack outcomes
supersedes: another repaired training run before failure-slice diagnosis

public_gates: M2255 must design a no-rerun diagnosis over existing M2244 and M2253 episode rows
M2255 must identify failure-slice axes for offtrack timing severity clearance and profile/seed roles
M2255 must define route rules for stronger repair curriculum guardrail repair synthesis or stop
M2255 must not run reset rollout training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts a new no-rerun evidence axis over existing episode rows before further repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design repeats aggregate outcome counts only
stop if design would run new training before slice diagnosis
stop if route rules do not separate offtrack collision and mixed failures
fallback_plan: route to no-rerun slice diagnosis implementation if design is complete
route to artifact repair if required episode rows are missing
route to stop if no actionable slice axes exist
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2254 pivoted to a new failure-slice branch

admission_evidence: M2254 pivoted away from bounded scalar reward repair
M2253 and M2244 both provide complete 480-row episode artifacts
M2253 worsens offtrack from 110 to 118 while return improves
allowed_updates: M2255 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2255 designs outcome-slice analysis and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2255; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Use slice evidence to choose repair or stop; do not lower self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: changes evidence axis from reward tweaking to failure-slice diagnosis
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can identify whether any current-sim repair route remains scientifically useful
must_synthesize_if: M2255 design cannot identify new slice axes
M2256 later only repeats aggregate offtrack counts
M2256 cannot choose repair or stop

hypothesis: A no-rerun failure-slice diagnosis design can identify why the bounded reward repair worsened offtrack outcomes before any further training.
success_criteria: M2244 and M2253 episode row sources are fixed
offtrack timing severity clearance and profile/seed axes are defined
route rules separate stronger repair guardrail repair synthesis and stop
guardrails block reset rollout training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims
a follow-up no-rerun implementation route is selected
failure_criteria: M2255 repeats aggregate counts without slice axes
M2255 starts new reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO or private holdout
M2255 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2255 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design of no-rerun offtrack failure-slice diagnosis

decision_rule: M2255 passes if it freezes a no-rerun failure-slice diagnosis over M2244 and M2253 episode rows without overclaiming.
